experiment: XB amendment A4: 128-token shared-span sensitivity arm (GPT-2 Small and Gemma-2-2B)
status: PRE-REGISTERED (frozen before any A4 run, including smoke)
approved_by: user, 2026-11-21 (priority 1 of Option B; subject to the team's cutoff extension)
evidence_level_on_completion: VALIDATION, sensitivity analysis (Pile validation / OWT shard 00077 samples; no TEST split exists for XB)
trigger: GPT-2 SAEs (R2 CTX=128; res-jb 128) are scored on ~700-token spans in the primary XB arm while Gemma Scope (trained at 1024) is in-distribution. Found from per-token L0 only (res-jb 15/68/61 at 128 tokens vs 580/415/180 on the 1024 shared span, layers 1/8/11); no XB outcome metric (dCE, KL, loss recovered, ratio) had been computed or inspected.
unchanged: primary 1024 shared and own runs and their frozen analysis (analysis_v1), reported exactly as pre-registered with the context caveat disclosed
documents, sets, ranks, SAEs, seeds, controls, gates, bootstrap (NB=1000, seed 0), Holm rules

design.documents: the frozen 512 eval + 64 reference documents of each corpus
design.span: longest prefix with <= 127 text tokens under BOTH tokenizers (01_build_xm_samples.span_end with the cap at 127; BOS prepended separately)
design.models_layers_saes: as the primary shared runs: GPT-2 all 12 layers resjb,old,r2; Gemma all 26 layers canonical 16k
design.scoring: BOS excluded; positions 1 <= t <= len-2; mean-ablation from the 64 reference docs at 128 tokens; norm-matched random; identity and repeat gates on the first 8 docs
design.runner: scripts/cross_model/05_xb_ctx128.py run ... (results root redirected to a4_ctx128/)

analyses.within_A4: 05_xb_ctx128.py analyze --tag a4 = the frozen 03 analysis on the A4 tree: XB_H1 (Holm within model x corpus), XB_H2 cross-model differences with the frozen +-15 % matched-stratum rule re-applied with L0 measured at 128 tokens, XB_H3 depth trend
analyses.context_change: 07_a4_context_comparison.py --tag a4: per (corpus, triplet slot, family pair, normalised metric) shrink = |d_1024| - |d_128| with the identical paired document resample; SHRINKS if CI low > 0, GROWS if CI high < 0, else NO CLEAR CHANGE; Holm over the whole table

pre_registered_reading.SHRINKS (Holm) on the normalised metrics: the 1024 cross-model gap is attributed partly to the GPT-2 context mismatch
pre_registered_reading.NO CLEAR CHANGE: the cross-model gap is not explained by context
pre_registered_reading.GROWS: reported as such; context mismatch does not account for the gap
pre_registered_reading.reporting: all slots and metrics reported; positive, negative and inconclusive rows listed separately

gates.V_IDENT/V_REPEAT: identity and original-repeat dCE exactly 0 (as primary)
gates.pairing: the same documents in the same rank order in both trees (asserted by hash in 07)
gates.integrity: 05 refuses to run unless the A4 tree copies are hash-identical to the derived manifests and inputs/m6

failure_conditions: any gate fails -> stop and report
a run cannot complete -> reported as incomplete; incomplete runs never enter 07 (DONE.json required)
compute: ~1.5 h per corpus for GPT-2, ~1 h per corpus for Gemma; < 0.5 GB outputs on EBS; RAM/GPU as the primary XB runs, run in the XB slot only after the primary XB runs have exited
